features: 【Package Includes】: Package Included 1pc remote control scrolling ring, 1pc charging cable.
【Material】: This Smart Remote Scrolling Ring is made of titanium steel, ensuring longevity and comfort for wear.
【Waterproof】: With an IPX8 waterproof rating, this remote ring remote can withstand water immersion for a certain period of time.
【Charging and WorkingTime】: The short video finger remote requires approximately 1 hour to fully charging, which can provide up to approximately 5 hours of usage time.
【Remote Control Page Turner】: When watching short video or reading, you do not need to keep sliding your fingers up and down the screen. You can watch video, take photos, and turn pages.
